item.coloph: bla ma'i rnam thar rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba/ sprul sku'i dbyil bon gyi gsung bzhin brjod cing yi ger btab pa la/ dang po stag lung gi drang srong lha rjes zhus/ de nas l-i stod kyi slob dpon mgon nes zhus/ des nas spa btsun gyis zhus cing btab brda ba la/ de la mtshan ldan bla ma'i zhal nas gsungs pa gcig las med pa la/ de gsum rang yang mi 'dra nor rer byung / de ma lags pa drung du ma rtags pa'i dpe'i khyab 'dong cig kun la khyab nas/ kha na mi 'dra ba rnams brjod cing brda' bas/ phyi rabs don du dol po'i shud kyi drang srong rgyal mtshan tshul khrims bdag gis drin can sprul sku'i zhabs drung du zhus cing brtugs (gtugs/) nor 'phrul ('khrul) lhag chad mdod lhad med par gsung bzhin bris/ phog rdug sgro skur dang bral byas nas/ 'chi ba rjes dran las khyad du mi bsod (gsod) pa rnams kyi don du/ mtshan ldan bla ma'i gsung bzhin dkar chag btab pa la/ don nor sdeb nyes 'gal ba byung srid na/ mkhyen ldan gong ma rnams la bzod par gsol/ de las byung ba'i dge ba gang mchis de/ 'gro ba ma lus thar pa'i bde gnas chen po thob par shog/
